title: ProbeArrivedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'probe.arrived'. STATE.md "Loombre Remote — embedded WireGuard + three-path wizard + reachability proof + posture card" (R6/R9): emitted when GET /probe/{token}'s single-use token is consumed by a real external request, lighting the wizard's reachability proof green. Distinct from the pre-existing 'probe.failed' event type (an unrelated ffprobe media-ingest failure, apps/worker/src/probe) — no naming collision, different subsystem entirely. R9's no-secrets rule: never carries the raw token, the hash, the caller's IP, or the expectedEndpoint it was bound to — `probeId` alone is enough to correlate against GET /admin/remote/probes/{id}. ADMIN-ONLY delivery, same posture as remote.enabled.
